Class CShapesVectorIngestor

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.CShapesVectorIngestor
public class CShapesVectorIngestor extends Object
High-Resolution Historical Vector Ingestor for CShapes 2.0 Dataset (1886-2019). Parses exact sovereign state boundaries, capital coordinates, and Gleditsch invalid input: '&' Ward (GW) codes with daily/monthly historical validity intervals [gwsdate, gwedate].

1.0.0
